780: pub(crate) fn string_dot_format_extra_positional_arguments(
781:     checker: &mut Checker,
782:     call: &ast::ExprCall,
783:     summary: &FormatSummary,
784:     args: &[Expr],
785: ) {
786:     // We can only fix if the positional arguments we're removing don't require re-indexing
787:     // the format string itself. For example, we can't fix `"{1}{2}".format(0, 1, 2)"`, since
788:     // this requires changing the format string to `"{0}{1}"`. But we can fix
789:     // `"{0}{1}".format(0, 1, 2)`, since this only requires modifying the call arguments.
790:     fn is_contiguous_from_end<T>(indexes: &[usize], target: &[T]) -> bool {
791:         if indexes.is_empty() {
792:             return true;
793:         }
794: 
795:         let mut expected_index = target.len() - 1;
796:         for &index in indexes.iter().rev() {
797:             if index != expected_index {
798:                 return false;
799:             }
800: 
801:             if expected_index == 0 {
802:                 break;
803:             }
804: 
805:             expected_index -= 1;
806:         }
807: 
808:         true
809:     }
